ArtifactReadParams.description: Read one bounded byte range from a content-addressed artifact. Session and lane are authorization targets, not caller identity; the daemon authenticates that scope independently.

range.description: One RFC 7233 bytes range. Multiple ranges are unsupported.

ArtifactReadResult.description: A bounded base64 JSON-RPC artifact response or a fixed, non-secret failure.

base64.description: Canonical standard base64 for at most 1 MiB of response bytes.
Canonical standard base64 for at most 1 MiB of response bytes.
